About

We build technology that disappears into the experience.

Neuralix Labs is an AI engineering studio. We build intelligent software, AI systems, and digital products — one real problem at a time.

Our philosophy

“The best technology feels simple on the surface and intelligently engineered underneath.”

We started Neuralix Labs to build the kind of software we actually wanted to use — AI systems that solve a real problem instead of performing intelligence for its own sake. That means being honest about what a model can and can’t do, and spending our effort on the engineering most AI projects skip: data pipelines, evaluation, and the unglamorous work of making something reliable in production.

What we believe

01

Research before implementation

We spend time understanding a problem before we decide a model is even the right tool for it.

02

Engineering over hype

A working system beats an impressive demo. We optimize for what survives contact with real usage.

03

Useful AI over gimmicks

If a feature exists to say "we have AI," we cut it. If it removes real friction, we keep it.

04

Human-centered design

The model is the engine, not the product. The product is what a person experiences using it.

05

Continuous iteration

We treat every launch as a first draft. The real signal shows up after people start using something.

The founder

Started by one person, built the same way we build for clients.

Neuralix Labs is run by Mayank Chauhan, an AI engineer based in Delhi-NCR, currently finishing a B.Tech in Artificial Intelligence. The studio exists because most student and early-stage projects stop at a notebook or a slide deck — Neuralix Labs is the practice of taking an idea all the way to a deployed, working system: model, API, frontend, and everything unglamorous in between.

“AI-native” is the operating principle, not a buzzword: directing modern AI tools to build and debug production systems end to end, and treating that as a real, marketable engineering skill — not a shortcut around one.

Who we are

A small, AI-native engineering studio — directing modern tools to build and debug end-to-end products, and treating that as a legitimate, marketable engineering skill.

What we build

AI products, intelligent automation, and the engineering underneath both — from a single model to a full production system.

Why we build

Because most AI projects stop at the demo. We’re interested in what happens after — when real people depend on something working.
